Introduction
This document outlines 
the equipment tests I1, which must performed on an annually bases 
as indicated by Y1 in the title block. The first draft 
initiated at High Dam HPS, by eng. Hossain Mahrous at 14 May 2002
The tests will be done after any fault on CT, 
at capital repair, and at acceptance tests.
Safety Precautions
Wear 
safety helmet, shoes, safety belt.
A work permit must be issued and
The qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
suitable safety category,
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area,
Wear 
safety helmet, shoes, safety belt.
Switch off the line 500kv.
Separate the primary 
and the secondary terminals of 
winding.
Switch on the grounds.
Presence the industrial safety 
supervisor.

Safety helmet, safety belt, 
 rags, and silicagel
Megger: isol 5003, 
 Device (ATRT-03)
